changeSet.sql: WITH ranked_entries AS ( SELECT spe.id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pe.procedure_id ORDER BY pe.id) AS key_document_version FROM system_progress_entry spe JOIN progress_entry pe ON spe.id = pe.id WHERE spe.system_progress_entry_type = 'APPOINTMENT_MODIFIED' ) UPDATE system_progress_entry spe SET key_document_type = 'INVITATION', key_document_version = re.key_document_version FROM ranked_entries re WHERE spe.id = re.id

changeSet.author: GA-Lotse
changeSet.sql: WITH ranked_entries AS ( SELECT spe.id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pe.procedure_id ORDER BY pe.id) AS key_document_version FROM system_progress_entry spe JOIN progress_entry pe ON spe.id = pe.id WHERE spe.system_progress_entry_type = 'SCHOOL_INFO_LETTER_GENERATED' ) UPDATE system_progress_entry spe SET key_document_type = 'SCHOOL_INFO_LETTER', key_document_version = re.key_document_version FROM ranked_entries re WHERE spe.id = re.id
